title: Mobile screen
description: Generates a mobile route, screen and feature that follow apps/mobile/AGENTS.md exactly.

name.description: Screen folder name in kebab-case (e.g. connection-status).

feature.description: Feature folder name in kebab-case. Defaults to the screen name.

route.description: Expo Router file name in kebab-case. Defaults to the screen name.

protected.description: Place the route under app/juntas/ so the session layout guards it.
